major.summary: Confounder candidate descriptions can disclose credential material to the client.
major.evidence: The projection copies event.description directly into the Work DTO. Manual Change Event creation persists the user-supplied bounded description unchanged, and the description schema has no secret-redaction rule. A recorded description containing an API key, bearer token, password, or similar credential would therefore render in the confounder disclosure. The existing URL redaction helper is applied only to matchedUrls.
major.impact: This violates the acceptance requirement that candidate descriptions and matched pages are safely projected with credential material withheld, and can expose secrets from recorded event context.
major.recommendation: Apply the repository's credential-safe text projection or withhold/redact unsafe descriptions before constructing the Work DTO, and add a server-render/read-model test covering a credential-like description.

do_not_change.summary: Preserve the single-statement candidate CTE and its event-level 51-item limit.
do_not_change.evidence: The candidate event selection, exact URL qualification, deterministic ordering, and matching-URL projection occur in one SQL statement; the CTE limits events before URL expansion.
do_not_change.impact: This preserves correct overflow detection and avoids a partial candidate set under concurrent record deletion.
do_not_change.recommendation: Keep this query shape while repairing safe description projection.
